page_title: UNI 1-2 LEV | Union Berlin v Bayer Leverkusen 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+3' The foul by Robert Skov (Union Berlin) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Christian Dingert.
90+3' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90+1' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukas Hradecky intercepts the ball.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
87' Flag goes up against Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
85' We are about to witness a subsitution. Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) for Leopold Querfeld.
85' The current number of shots on goal is 2:3.

83' An accurate cross picks out Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
81' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the resultant free kick towards the left post, but the keeper makes a brilliant save and denies him the chance to score.
80' Dangerous play by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin). Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a free kick.
79' Substitution. Jeremie Frimpong makes his way off the pitch and Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on as his replacement.
79' The game has come to an end for Arthur. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Christopher Trimmel cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Bo Svensson has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Robert Skov (Union Berlin) replacing Woo-Yeong Jeong.
79' It will be a substitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Rani Khedira walks off.
76' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
75' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
73' No handball! Referee Christian Dingert points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Bayer Leverkusen players.
72' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The Bayer Leverkusen players aren’t happy.
71' 1 - 2 It’s a GOAL! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) is the first to get on the end of a lofted pass and bundles the ball into the net with his body.
70' CHANCE! Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) receives a brilliant pass and finds himself one-on-one with Lukas Hradecky, who reacts superbly to stop him.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) will replace Tim Skarke.
67' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
65' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
65' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
63' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) sees a yellow card from Christian Dingert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
62' Bayer Leverkusen keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
58' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Robert Andrich.
58' The substitution is prepared. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aleix Garcia.
58' A cross from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

56' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
56' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner.

55' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Union Berlin.
54' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
50' Frederik Ronnow leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen).
50' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
49' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
47' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Christian Dingert blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+1' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
44' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
43' Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) brings his opponent down. Christian Dingert has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul and Christian Dingert immediately signals a free kick.
41' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
38' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
37' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) steps up to send the ball in.
37' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
36' Bayer Leverkusen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

34' A big opportunity missed by Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen). He got on the ball inside the box and thumped a splendid first-time shot on goal, but it went narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
32' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) makes a strong challenge and Christian Dingert blows for a foul.

29' 1 - 1 Benedict Hollerbach passes the ball into the penalty area. Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) collects it and quickly sends it into the bottom right corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:1!

29' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
28' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
28' Rough tackle by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded the free kick.

27' A sweet pass finds Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Lukas Hradecky is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
26' The ball possession at the moment is 45:55.
24' Christian Dingert blows his whistle as Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

23' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
21' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
20' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
17' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
15' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
13' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
12' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
10' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
7' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) connects with the free kick and produces a header goalwards which is well blocked. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about that one.
4' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Union Berlin was in an offside position.

2' 0 - 1 Goal! Alejandro Grimaldo shows great vision to find Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen).
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayer Leverkusen will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Christian Dingert.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
